text:
glasses_dana: Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 for late evening, but today at 22:59 it was at nightstand_b1. This contradicts the "kitchen shift" heuristic for late night. Glasses seem to return to nightstand_b1 for sleep, overriding the kitchen location. Check nightstand_b1 for times after 22:00. Do not default to kitchen_table_k1 for glasses in the very late evening.

mug_dana: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for late evening, but today at 10:21 it was at desk_o1 and at 14:10 it was at sink_k1. Mugs are highly mobile during work hours, often found at desk_o1 (work) or sink_k1 (cleaning/refill). The "coffee_table_l1" hub is unreliable for mugs during the day. Check desk_o1 and sink_k1 for mugs between 09:00 and 17:00. Only default to coffee_table_l1 for late evening (post-21:00) if not recently seen at desk/sink.

water_bottle_dana: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for mid-day, but today at 14:11 it was at sink_k1 and at 17:24 it was at desk_o1. Like mugs, water bottles are not static at the coffee table during work hours. They move to desk_o1 (work) or sink_k1 (refill). Check desk_o1 and sink_k1 for water bottles between 09:00 and 18:00. Do not default to coffee_table_l1 during the workday.

General Pattern: The "coffee_table_l1 as central hub" heuristic is ONLY reliable for early morning (pre-09:00) and late evening (post-21:00) for mugs and water bottles. During work hours (09:00-18:00), Dana’s items (mugs, water bottles, glasses) frequently move to desk_o1 (work) or sink_k1 (refill/clean). For glasses specifically, they return to nightstand_b1 for sleep (post-22:00), not the kitchen. Always check desk_o1 and sink_k1 for Dana’s drinkware during the day.
